user.title: Set up Redstone Assistant
user.description: This turns on the websocket commands your Redstone Assistant Minecraft mod connects to. There's nothing to fill in here - inside Minecraft, generate a long-lived access token from your Home Assistant profile (Settings > your profile > Security) and enter this instance's URL and the token in the mod's Home Server block.

abort.already_configured: Redstone Assistant is already set up.
